description: Practice-mode Puffly dealer for Four-in-a-Row. Column drops (C0–C6) plus Trigger_Puff, Trigger_Thinking, and Trigger_Humble. v1.0.10 / client build 550 — settle to IDLE before endgame Trigger_Puff on Puffly win.

Trigger_C0.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 0 (leftmost).

Trigger_C1.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 1.

Trigger_C2.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 2.

Trigger_C3.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 3 (center).

Trigger_C4.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 4.

Trigger_C5.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 5.

Trigger_C6.notes: Fire when Puffly drops in column 6 (rightmost).

Trigger_Puff.notes: One-shot Chest_Puff (~2s → IDLE). Mid-game: block or unavoidable-win trap. Endgame: fire when Puffly wins, before the celebration overlay (~2s hold).

Trigger_Thinking.notes: One-shot Puffly_Thinking (~3s → IDLE). Fire when the human drops in a column that was Puffly's immediate winning threat. Wait ~3s before Puffly's next move.

Trigger_Humble.notes: One-shot Humble_Gesture (~2s → IDLE). Fire when Puffly loses (human wins), after the final drop and before the celebration overlay.

wiring.computer_turn: On Puffly AI column choice, fire Trigger_C{col} then run animateFourDrop / applyFourInARowDrop. If the move is a block or unavoidable-win trap (and not a win), also fire Trigger_Puff. If Puffly wins, wait for column reach → IDLE (~600ms settle), fire Trigger_Puff, wait ~2s, then show celebration.
wiring.human_turn: Do not fire column triggers for human drops. If the human blocks Puffly's immediate win threat, fire Trigger_Thinking and wait ~3s before the computer turn. If the human wins, fire Trigger_Humble, wait ~2s, then show celebration.
wiring.endgame: Hold celebration overlay until the 2s Humble/Puff endgame reaction finishes so Puffly stays fully visible.
wiring.reduced_motion: If prefers-reduced-motion, skip Rive and keep skeleton PNGs.

fallback.notes: Keep existing skeleton PNGs visible if Rive fails to load or is skipped.
